description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts consistently across a web application. It handles formatting of numeric values as currency strings with features such as dynamic decimal precision, optional inclusion of credits (e.g., for in-app currency), and specific handling for USD currency. The functions ensure a uniform display of currency values, including proper locale-aware formatting and customizable options.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits and dynamic precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD with credits appended, forwarding options to formatCurrencyAmount.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separators and up to six decimal places.
